body:
## [3.93.0] - 2026-10-06

### Features

- allow five-digit item prices (AION-523)
- enhance purchase recommendations with pending transfer handling
- add purchase recommendations feature
- complete resilient stock workflows
- add inventory transfer exceeds available stock message in multiple languages and update error handling
- implement inventory error message handling and add unit tests
- add scroll controllers to receipt, transfer, and vendor return dialogs for improved scrolling experience
- refactor receipt and transfer dialogs for improved line management and UI updates
- enhance inventory settings and policies
- add new transfer states in multiple languages and update related UI components
- add employee selection for transfer receipt confirmation and enhance transfer validation
- update internal transfer and receipt screen titles across multiple languages
- add new inventory and transfer related strings in Russian, Arabic, English, Hebrew
- enhance vendor return functionality with original receipt handling and configuration options
- add vendor return functionality
- Enhance receipt management with manual product addition and packaging options
- Enhance receipt management with employee assignment and carton updates
- Remove unused inventory navigation items from sidebar and app drawer
- Implement internal transfer validation and enhance product deletion functionality
- Add predefined discount buttons and localization support
- Enhance internal transfer functionality with employee and receipt management
- Refactor delivery and receipt dialogs to enhance UI and functionality
- add warehouse selection to delivery and receipt dialogs
- add internal transfer functionality and localization updates
- add loading indicators and refresh functionality to deliveries, internal transfers, and receipts screens

### Bug Fixes

- enhance dropdowns in new transfer dialog for better usability
- protect draft lines and recovery context
- update showInventoryMenu handling and improve error management in settings sync
- surface list API errors
- preserve policies and remove deliveries from POS navigation
- address permissions recovery navigation and receipt actions
- preserve each selected row discount (AION-517)
- display promotions beneath their applied items (AION-517)
- update DropdownButtonFormField to use 'value' instead of 'initialValue'

### Other Changes

- Update subproject commit reference for flutter_pos_api
